text: Professional OverviewJournalism and communication studies are interdisciplinary fields that study the laws of information dissemination, the operation mechanisms of media, and their social impacts. Journalism focuses on news production, dissemination and public opinion guidance, and pays attention to fact collection, writing and editing. Communication studies explore information transmission models (such as interpersonal communication, organizational communication, and mass communication) from a broader perspective, and investigate the interactive relationship between media and society, culture, and politics. The two have deeply integrated in the digital age, forming a discipline cluster of "journalism and communication", which combines theoretical speculation and practical innovation attributes. For instance, it analyzes the impact of short-video platforms on the public opinion ecosystem or explores how algorithmic recommendations shape the information cocoon.Training ObjectivesCultivate compound talents with solid theoretical foundation in news communication, proficient in multimedia content production skills, familiar with the trend of media convergence, and capable of engaging in news gathering and editing, brand communication, public opinion analysis, digital marketing and other work in traditional media, Internet platforms, corporate communication, government public relations and other fields. Specific goals include:Master the classic theories of journalism and communication (such as Lasswell's 5W model and McLuhan's "The medium is the message") and empirical research methods;Possess cross-media content production capabilities such as text writing, video shooting, short video production, and data visualization;Understand the reconstruction of the communication ecosystem by new media technologies (such as AI news writing and VR reporting), and be able to use data analysis tools (such as Python and Tableau) to interpret communication effects;Cultivate media ethics awareness (such as the principle of news authenticity and privacy protection) and a global communication perspective (such as international public opinion analysis and cross-cultural communication strategies).
